text:
maria_cs: Heads up — AtlasCove (trial) asked for a temporary regional QPS bump in eu-west-1 for a customer demo on Mon. They also need an IP allowlist and SSO callback hostname whitelisted. Renewal conversation next month, they're sensitive to latency. Can we coordinate?

jake_support: Noted. How big of a bump are they asking for?

priya_eng: We can support a 3x QPS bump for a 48h window from the EU edge. We'll need CIDRs for the egress and the exact SSO callback host. Also recommend enabling prefix/KV caching for the demo to keep p95 down.

avery_ae: I'll get those from the customer. They said traffic will originate from a set of GCP static IPs and from a SaaS SSO provider. I'll drop the list here when I have it.

tom_infra: I can create a temporary rate rule and an allowlist entry. We require an auto-revoke TTL on temp bumps — ops policy. What TTL do you want?

maria_cs: 72h TTL should be fine. Please make the bump start Friday 07:00 UTC so they can do internal dry-runs before Mon demo.

lara_ops: Adding note — any temporary bump must be tied to a ticket and have rollback triggers (error rate >5% or latency >400ms). I'll create CS-8421 and link here.

deploy-bot: [system] Creating ticket CS-8421 and provisioning change request.

jake_support: Customer forwarded CIDRs: `35.190.0.0/16`, `34.144.0.0/12`. Callback host: `sso.atlascove.com`. They also asked if we can pin routing to eu-west-1 for the demo.

priya_eng: Thanks — will set model route pin for eu-west-1 (canary) and enable prefix cache. Suggest quantization profile stay default for accuracy during trial.

tom_infra: Changes staged. Snippet of what I'm applying: `rate_window: 3x`, `scope: atlascove-trial`, `allowlist: [35.190.0.0/16,34.144.0.0/12]`, `region_pin: eu-west-1`, `auto_revoke: 72h`.

deploy-bot: Change applied to staging; will promote to prod at 2026-06-12T07:00:00Z if no blockers.

priya_eng: I'll watch p95 and KV hit rate during the dry-run. If p95 falls above 180ms we'll revert the pin and throttle back.

jake_support: Uploaded CIDRs and callback host to secure config vault. Notified SRE oncall.

maria_cs: Please add a one-line renewal note: "AtlasCove expects <150ms p95 in EU demo; positive demo likely to convert to paid tier next month." Put that in renewal tracker.

lara_ops: CS-8421 updated with TTL, rollback rules, and renewal note. Also set an action item to capture post-demo feedback on perceived latency and token cost.

tom_infra: Temp bump + allowlist live. Auto-revoke scheduled (epoch 3467917928). Current eu-west p95 ~132ms right after pin — monitoring. Tagging @oncall.

avery_ae: :thumbsup: I'll run the 10am PDT checklist with the customer and capture feedback in the ticket.

maria_cs: Great work everyone — please drop any post-demo notes in CS-8421 and ping me if any regression appears.

lara_ops: Closing out the coordination thread here. Reopen if we need to extend the TTL or adjust rules.
